layout.aiTipBody: Every record can carry the full story.

overview.description: Keep every relationship, follow-up and opportunity in one calm workspace.

contacts.description: Build a complete, usable source of truth for every relationship.

companies.description: Understand the people, context and commercial value behind every account.

leads.description: Qualify interest and move the right conversations forward.

deals.description: See every opportunity, owner and next step without losing context.

activities.description: Turn conversations into visible follow-through for the whole team.

notes.description: Capture decisions and context where the team can actually use them.

segments.description: Create focused audiences from the data already in your workspace.

import.description: Bring existing relationships into Lulu with a safe, reviewable import.

ai.description: Let Lulu surface context and next actions while people stay in control.

settings.description: Shape fields, statuses, roles and consent rules around your workspace.
